summary: Frontend E2E testing for 360 Degree Secure completed. Admin login redirect to dashboard works, JWT token stored in localStorage, all dashboard tabs render, Workshops CRUD works, Content save works, Enquiries status change + CSV export + delete work, public enquiry forms on /contact, /krav-maga, /workshops, /law-enforcement all submit successfully, logout clears token and redirects to /admin/login, all public pages load without console errors and images render (after normal load).

ui_bugs.issue: Success toast (top-right) visually overlaps the LOGOUT button immediately after login/save actions. With normal user click (no force) the toast can intercept the pointer for ~5s. Playwright required waiting for toast to fade before logout click succeeded. Consider positioning toasts below the header or lowering toast z-index over interactive header buttons.

action_items: Minor UX: reposition/shrink the top-right toast so it does not overlap the LOGOUT button in the admin header (or auto-dismiss faster / add pointer-events:none while toast idle).
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.logout correctly removes token from localStorage and calls setUser(false) — verified.
api.js request interceptor attaches Authorization Bearer from localStorage — verified via successful authenticated requests.
Login flow returns {user, token}, token persisted, redirect to /admin succeeds on first attempt — the previously reported stale-bundle/cookie issue is resolved.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 TEST_ prefixed enquiries via public forms; all deleted at end of test. Created and deleted 1 TEST_ workshop. Content hero_title was modified to 'Test Hero Title QA' (main agent may want to restore original content).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All admin flows verified working end-to-end via Bearer token in localStorage. Public forms all submit successfully. Only cosmetic overlap between toast and logout button noted. Content hero_title was overwritten to 'Test Hero Title QA' during testing — may need reset.
rca of the issue: N/A — previously reported admin-login redirect failure is fixed. Auth now uses Bearer header + withCredentials:false; login response returns {user,token} and axios interceptor sends Authorization on subsequent requests.
